title: Claude soch raha ho tab ad se paise
content:
Bhai, ab tum Claude se 100 dollar kama sakte ho.
Tareeka bahut seedha hai.
Video save kar lo.
Main saare steps batata hoon.

Dekho, abhi main Claude use kar raha tha.
Prompt diya, aur Claude apne thinking mode mein chala gaya.
Isi thinking mode ki jagah tum ek ad laga sakte ho.
Wahi ad dekhne se tumhe bahut paise milenge.
Isse roz 200 dollar tak kama sakte ho.

Agar step by step guide chahiye, aur tool ka link chahiye, to comment kar do, tool.
Reel mujhe share kar dena.
Details seedhe tumhare DM mein aa jaayengi.
Ya mere WhatsApp channel se bhi le sakte ho.
Link bio mein hai.
Milte hain agle video mein.
